> 🔀 Delegated to the **platform** agent

I've started this as task `t_4acdd4f5`. The answer will post into this thread as soon as it's ready.

Task `t_4acdd4f5` has finished with status **done** (assigned to `platform`).

Here is the complete result from the task:

## What's wrong
Shoppers encountered errors on catalog requests because the `search-api` service in the `storefront` namespace had 0 active endpoints due to all `search-api` pods failing their readiness probes (`readiness probe failed: Get "http://<pod-ip>:9099/": dial tcp <pod-ip>:9099: connect: connection refused`).

## Why
- **Port Mismatch:** In [Deployment/search-api](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/deployment/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260915-212011/storefront/search-api/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) (`tasks/b-0022b/10-workloads.yaml`), the container listens on port `8085` (`args: ["-listen=:8085", "-text=ok"]`, `containerPort: 8085`), but the `readinessProbe` was configured to probe port `9099`.
- **Unready Endpoints:** Because the readiness probe refused connections on port 9099, the pods were marked unready (`0/1 Running`) and excluded from the [Service/search-api](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/service/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260915-212011/storefront/search-api/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) endpoint pool.

## What to do
- **Remediated Manifest in GitOps Branch:** Pushed fix commit [`2978e23`](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/commit/2978e238dba35661b369c0d54fa5727038933b2a) to target branch [`run/gitops-pilot-20260915-212011/b-0022b`](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/tree/run/gitops-pilot-20260915-212011/b-0022b) correcting `readinessProbe.httpGet.port` to `8085` in `tasks/b-0022b/10-workloads.yaml`.
- **Verified Rollout:** Argo CD synced revision `2978e238dba35661b369c0d54fa5727038933b2a` on cluster [gitops-pilot-20260915-212011](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260915-212011/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos). Both `search-api` replicas are now healthy and ready (`2/2 Running`), and endpoints are active (`192.0.2.18:8085`, `192.0.2.14:8085`).

## Sources
- GKE Cluster & Workload APIs (`mcp__gke__get_k8s_resource`, `mcp__gke__list_k8s_events`, `mcp__gke__describe_k8s_resource`)
- Developer Knowledge MCP (`mcp__developer_knowledge__answer_query`)
- GitOps repository: [gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra)
